packageRules.description: Bump the floors of dev/test tooling so they track what we pin elsewhere (pre-commit revs, CI), which makes the ruff/uv/mypy lockstep groups update both sides. Runtime deps under project.dependencies keep their loose floors on purpose: weav ships as a wheel and must not over-constrain consumers, so uv.lock (see lockFileMaintenance) is what keeps those current.
Group dev/test tooling (Python) into one PR
Group all GitHub Actions bumps into one PR
Group remaining pre-commit hook bumps into one PR
Keep ruff and ruff-pre-commit in lockstep (same upstream release, two managers). Listed after the generic pre-commit group so it wins for ruff-pre-commit.
Keep uv and uv-pre-commit in lockstep (same upstream release, two managers). Listed after the generic pre-commit group so it wins for uv-pre-commit.
Keep mypy and mirrors-mypy in lockstep (same upstream release, two managers). Listed after the generic pre-commit group so it wins for mirrors-mypy.
